inputs.name: hand over from Canary and A/B Testing to Model Serving Endpoint

output.level_0: The handover from testing to serving crashes, dropping all traffic.
output.level_1: No defined path exists to move tested models to the serving endpoint.
output.level_2: Engineers manually copy tested models to the endpoint, risking configuration errors.
output.level_3: A pipeline automatically deploys tested models to the endpoint without human intervention.
output.level_4: Automated deployment includes audit logs and policy checks before reaching the endpoint.
